# Mutation check: the generated C# specs catch broken implementations
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #106, sha256:12e06eac4cbe8bff07f74e3c797178ff933d9fd18a1df84e0cec728aa5aa1677). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Done 2026-10-27 (commits ba46d76 and 8f17eac, authored by Codex; nine deterministic mutants: 9 of 9 killed on the committed mutation fixture, 8 of 9 on the unchanged orders.phrase whose positive-quantity phrase lacks a success spec; round 2 fixed Grok's objection; Decider D75 passed)
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** feature (thin slice; a test-quality check)
- **Milestone:** Tests first: spec to test is the reliable artifact
- **Source:** Steve's direction ruling relayed by Dispatch, 2026-10-27 (keep Phrase's own deterministic compilers; test-code generation first, then implementation code; the LLM-as-compiler path is a hypothesis measured alongside, not instead) and Decider D74 (Codex, Copilot, Grok Support-it). The measure-first cards (102, 103) stay ahead of these.
- **Depends on:** 087
- **Story:** As Dana, I want the specs generated from orders.phrase to fail when the implementation is broken, so that a green run means the behaviour I specified is really there.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given a hand-written correct implementation of each phrase in orders.phrase and a fixed list of mutation operators (flip a comparison, drop a Fail call, change a constant by one, return early, swap two arguments), When each mutant is built and the generated specs are run against it, Then the number of killed mutants over mutants that build is reported per phrase and in total
  2. Given the totals, When they are checked, Then at least 90 percent of the mutants that build are killed, and every surviving mutant is listed by phrase and operator (the check fails below the threshold and names the survivors)
  3. Given the check, When it runs twice on the same inputs, Then it reports identical numbers (deterministic; no model involved)

## Context

- Tests first (Decider D74). A surviving mutant is a finding about the specs or the spec to test generator, not a reason to loosen the 90 percent threshold; fix by adding a spec in the fixture or a generator change in its own slice.
- Mutants are applied to the native csharp bodies of a temp copy of the module (never the repository), built with MSBUILDDISABLENODEREUSE=1, and stopped by exact PID only. Keep the first slice small: the operators above on the three leaf phrases of orders.phrase.
